name: Sayo Shrine-Cartographer
lore: Sayo reads how invisible shrine paths fold around Mythos Gates. Her maps show safe passage, forbidden crossings, and where battlefields will shift after spirit disturbances.
physicalDescription: Shrine cartographer in layered dark lacquer robes, white fox mask at the hip, ink-brush compass, spirit-paper ribbons floating around map scrolls.
gameplayFunction: Map briefing source, terrain warning voice, Kami lore unlock source.
